risks.note: The MD&A Risks and Concerns section states the industry operates under stringent government monitoring and regulations encompassing both central and state laws, and that this active government involvement amplifies the risk profile for distilleries including the Company. Compliance with licensing requirements, production standards and product quality controls is continuous, and failure to meet them can result in penalties, legal consequences and reputational damage. risks.note: Management flags this as a significant challenge: prohibitions significantly impact market potential and revenue streams for distilleries operating in those regions, restricting the addressable target market and creating obstacles to expanding operations, potentially hindering growth opportunities.
risks.risk: Prohibition — bans on liquor consumption in certain states

risks.note: Molasses is the Company's base raw material and its sole production route. Management notes the deficient monsoon may have caused lower sugarcane acreage, which may influence molasses availability and pricing. The industry section adds that the Government's cap on B-heavy molasses and sugarcane-juice ethanol just before sugar year 2023-24 created feedstock-policy uncertainty and led to panic buying that pushed molasses prices to exorbitant levels.
risks.risk: Molasses feedstock availability and price volatility

risks.note: The demand case rests substantially on the Government's Ethanol Blending Programme, where the next year's target is 20%. Because the same policy lever that creates the opportunity (diversion of cane to ethanol) was reversed by the GOI cap, the Company's feedstock economics and offtake are both exposed to discretionary policy change rather than market demand alone.

Management states the evolving nature of laws and regulations in the distillery industry introduces uncertainty and a need for continuous adaptation, and that changes in taxation policies, labelling requirements, production standards or advertising restrictions can have a direct impact on business operations and profitability.
risks.risk: Exposure to changes in taxation, labelling, production standards and advertising restrictions

risks.note: Listed under Threats in the SCOT analysis: a highly competitive environment where several manufacturers vie for market dominance. The Chairman adds that India's progress on ethanol blending has brought sharper competition alongside wider opportunity for producers of all sizes.

risks.note: All products are manufactured at the one distillery at Walchandnagar, Maharashtra, of approximately 40 acres, which is also the registered office. The annual report discloses no second manufacturing location, so any disruption at that site — utility, environmental, excise or weather related — affects the whole of output.

The Company has 56 permanent employees on its rolls and relies on an independent Chartered Accountant engaged to conduct internal audits to verify recording and reporting practices, rather than an in-house internal-audit function. As an NSE Emerge (SME Exchange) listed entity it is exempt from SEBI Corporate Governance Regulations 17 to 27 and from BRSR, so neither a Corporate Governance Report nor a BRSR forms part of this annual report — the usual structured risk and ESG disclosure is therefore absent.

currentContext.expansion: Alcokraft operates a single distillery spread over approximately 40 acres at Walchandnagar, Maharashtra, described in the Corporate Overview as having a capacity of 270 lakh litres per annum. The expansion agenda disclosed for FY26 is diversification rather than brownfield debottlenecking of the spirit line. First, on 27th December 2025 the Company incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Alcomaster Beverages Private Limited, to undertake manufacturing, processing, distilling, blending, bottling, packaging, marketing, distribution and sale of grain-based liquor and other potable alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages — a move into potable alcohol alongside the existing non-potable base; the subsidiary had not commenced business activity as at 31st March 2026. Second, subsequent to the close of the financial year the Board considered and approved installation of a Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) Plant with a capacity of 10 Tons Per Day, has initiated implementation steps, and has begun applying for a bank loan to finance the project; no commissioning date, cost or timeline is stated. Third, the MD&A says the Company is actively expanding its product line and venturing into ethanol production. Historic capability investments referenced are the shift from manual to automated distillation in 2015-16, implementation of solid waste management technology in 2019 that yields potash fertilizer and de-potash vinasse, integration of an evaporation system to cut effluent quantity, and establishment of a 1 MW captive solar power plant at the factory site during 2022-23. The Company states it invests continually in technology upgrades, process efficiency and capacity expansion, but the annual report gives no rupee quantum for any of it.

- All products are manufactured at the one distillery at Walchandnagar, Maharashtra, of approximately 40 acres, which is also the registered office. - The Company has 56 permanent employees on its rolls and relies on an independent Chartered Accountant engaged to conduct internal audits to verify recording and reporting practices, rather than an in-house internal-audit function. As an NSE Emerge (SME Exchange) listed entity it is exempt from SEBI Corporate Governance Regulations 17 to 27 and from BRSR, so neither a Corporate Governance Report nor a BRSR forms part of this annual report — the usual structured risk and ESG disclosure is therefore absent.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthen operational efficiency — the Chairman names this as the first of three stated priorities for the year ahead
- Deepen presence in existing markets while exploring new ones, including scaling the export/international footprint
- Continue investing in distillation technology and process upgrades to keep product quality ahead of expectation
- Expand the product line into ethanol production to capture comprehensive value from the molasses stream
- Diversify into potable, grain-based liquor through the newly incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Alcomaster Beverages Private Limited

hero.oneLiner: Alcokraft Distilleries Limited (formerly Aurangabad Distillery Limited) is a molasses-based non-potable alcohol manufacturer operating a single 40-acre distillery at Walchandnagar, Maharashtra with a capacity of 270 lakh litres per annum.
